def: properly, a whisper, i.e. by implication, (in a good sense) a private prayer, (in a bad one) an incantation; concretely, an amulet

words.word: among you which will not be charmed

occurrences.text: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment; and a babbler is no better.
Lord, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.
For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which will not be charmed, and they shall bite you, saith the Lord.
words: among you which will not be charmed
